g.text: PF-M. On reference comparison dates, how much smaller (or larger) is GALE-CAST Model-W1's error? Paired
Evidence D (panel request). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical
Point = GALE-CAST Model-W1 MAE minus the comparison's MAE on the same reference comparison station-dates; line = 95% paired circular block-bootstrap interval over target dates (14-day blocks, 2,000

resamples). An interval entirely left of 0 means GALE-CAST Model-W1's smaller error is established on these dates. The grey control (average of persistence and climatology, no model) shows how much of
any advantage a simple hedge also gets. Rule and data as PF-L. Run panel-v3-20261025T163630Z-5e7b69.
